import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Read input data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get sample_submission template to ensure correct format
target_columns = [col for col in sample_submission.columns if col != "id"]

# Separate features and targets
X_train_full = train["comment_text"]
y_train_full = train[target_columns].values.astype(float)
X_test = test["comment_text"]
X_test_ids = test["id"].values

# Split training data into train and validation sets (80/20) WITH STRATIFICATION
X_train_indices, X_val_indices, y_train_full_idx, y_val_full = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(X_train_full)),
    y_train_full,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_full,
    shuffle=True,
)

X_train = X_train_full.iloc[X_train_indices]
X_val = X_train_full.iloc[X_val_indices]
y_train = y_train_full.values[X_train_indices]
y_val = y_val_full.values[X_val_indices]

# Vectorize the text
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2))
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Initialize storage for models, predictions and metrics
models = []
val_metrics = {}

# Train independent logistic regression for each target class
for col_idx, col in enumerate(target_columns):
    # Reshape for single classifier
    y_col = y_train[:, col_idx]

    clf = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, random_state=42, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
    clf.fit(X_train_vec, y_col)
    models.append(clf)

    # Validation metrics - compute AUC on held-out validation set with CORRECTLY MATCHED LABELS
    val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 0, 1)  # Handle numerical precision issues

    # Ensure matching lengths for valid computation
    assert len(y_col) == len(
        val_probs_clipped
    ), f"Mismatch: {len(y_col)} vs {len(val_probs_clipped)}"

    val_metrics[col] = roc_auc_score(y_col, val_probs_clipped)

    print(f"Validation ROC-AUC for {col}: {val_metrics[col]:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set using stored models
test_predictions = {
    col: models[col_idx].predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]
    for col_idx, col in enumerate(target_columns)
}
test_predictions = {
    col: np.clip(test_predictions[col], 0, 1) for col in test_predictions
}

# Print column-wise validation ROC-AUC
print("\nColumn-wise ROC-AUC on Hold-Out Validation Set:")
total_auc = 0
for col in target_columns:
    print(f"{col}: {val_metrics[col]:.6f}")
    total_auc += val_metrics[col]

mean_auc = total_auc / len(target_columns)
print(f"\nMean Column-Wise ROC-AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Create submission file WITH ID column included properly
submission_data = sample_submission.copy()
for col in target_columns:
    submission_data[col] = test_predictions[col]

submission_data = submission_data.sort_values("id")
submission_data = submission_data.reset_index(drop=True)

# Save predictions to submission.csv
submission_data["id"] = submission_data["id"].astype(str)
submission_data.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
